'''mc9457 So Much Red''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[mc9457]]
* '''Published:''' 4 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif|label=Hidden Base}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hidden Base
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 HB mc9457 LS 2001 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Another post RII deck...very sweet, very evil.  Your friends will stop playing you after you play this deck.

== Strategy ==

Start pulling the 0s out right away.  Don't worry about the AFAs+Odds cards
with Signal - pull Polarized Negative Power Coupling, Eyes in the Dark,
Strike Planning, and Echo Base Garrison first (in that order).  You will
pull AFA and Odds into hand as you are doing it.  Oola is not hard to come
into hand most of the time.  Deploy her on a starship quickly and start
manipulating your opponent's hand down into their used pile (Grimtaash
pulled via Scrambled Transmission to get their hand down from 13 to 8).
Polarized Negative Power Coupling+Visored Vision = 2 force loss during their
turn at least (unless facing a deck that has no interrupts in it).  Surprise
Assault?  Have enough high destinies in the deck, might as well use them.
